Title: Return Policy
Summary: How long customers have to return an item and what condition it must be in.
Article_Body__c: Most items can be returned within 30 days of the delivery date for a full refund to the original payment method. Items must be unused, in their original packaging, and include all accessories. Final-sale and clearance items are not eligible for return. To start a return, contact support with your order number - a team member will provide a prepaid return label and process the refund once the item is received and inspected.

Title: Standard Shipping Timelines
Summary: How long orders take to ship and arrive under standard and expedited shipping.
Article_Body__c: Orders are processed within 1 business day of purchase. Standard shipping typically takes 5-7 business days from the ship date; expedited shipping takes 2-3 business days. Delivery times may run a day or two longer for remote areas. Once an order ships, a tracking number is sent by email.

Title: Warranty Terms
Summary: What the standard manufacturer warranty covers and how to file a claim.
Article_Body__c: All products include a 1-year manufacturer warranty covering defects in materials and workmanship. The warranty does not cover accidental damage, misuse, or normal wear and tear. To file a warranty claim, contact support with your order number and a description of the issue; approved claims are resolved with a repair, replacement, or store credit at our discretion.

Title: Exchange Process
Summary: How to exchange an item for a different size, color, or model within the return window.
Article_Body__c: Items can be exchanged for a different size, color, or model within the same 30-day window as our return policy, as long as the item is unused and in its original packaging. There is no restocking fee for exchanges. Contact support with your order number to start an exchange; once the original item is received, the replacement ships within 1-2 business days.

Title: Damaged or Wrong Item Received
Summary: What to do if an order arrives damaged or the wrong item was shipped.
Article_Body__c: If an order arrives damaged or you received the wrong item, report it within 14 days of delivery. Include a photo of the item and its packaging when you contact support with your order number. There is no charge for return shipping in these cases, and you can choose a replacement or a full refund once the issue is confirmed.
